claim: For every finite nonempty edge-transitive simple graph \(H=(V,E)\), put \(G=\mathbb F_2^V\), \(\Omega_H=\{0\}\cup\{e_u+e_v:uv\in E\}\), \(m=|E|\), and \(M=\operatorname{MAXCUT}(H)\). Then the Turán extremum \(\tau(H)=\sup\{\sum_{x\in G}f(x):f(0)=1,\ f\text{ positive definite},\ \operatorname{supp}f\subseteq\Omega_H\}\) satisfies \(\tau(H)=2M/(2M-m)=\chi_q(H)\), where \(\chi_q\) is Šámal's cubical chromatic number. A sharp extremizer is given by \(f(0)=1\) and \(f(e_u+e_v)=1/(2M-m)\) on every edge. For every odd cycle \(H=C_{2k+1}\), this normalized extremizer is unique and \(\tau(C_{2k+1})=4k/(2k-1)\).
integrity: The harmonic proof is self-contained apart from standard finite-group Fourier positivity and the cited graph identity relating fractional cut-cover and cubical chromatic number. The complete-graph specialization is not presented as the source of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for finite nonempty edge-transitive simple graphs. No all-graph formula or all-graph equality classification is asserted. Finite enumerations are corroborative only.
title: Turán constants of Boolean edge shells on edge-transitive graphs
